cases.title: Crossing Pedestrian: B0 Blind Commitment vs B1 Perceptual Rerouting

mode_b0_baseline.hazard_description: Commits straight forward through corridor despite crossing entity exiting FOV in 1.45s, blinding forward tracking.

mode_b1_stage_a.hazard_description: Straight corridor rejected (support 0.335 < 0.40). Successfully reroutes to RIGHT corridor (support 0.909 >= 0.40).

cases.scientific_significance: Proves Stage-A prevents blind corridor commitment when obstacle observation cannot be guaranteed over horizon H.

cases.title: Blind Uncertainty: Rapid FOV Flank Loss

mode_b0_baseline.failure_mode: Navigates blind on right flank because instant bearing (+28.5 deg) is within FOV at t=0.

mode_b1_stage_a.protection_mode: Anticipates FOV exit at t=0.27s. Demotes right corridors (support 0.00) and executes safe alternative.

cases.scientific_significance: Demonstrates why instantaneous checks (Level B/C) fail while trajectory propagation (Stage-A) succeeds.

cases.title: Threshold Sensitivity: Permissive tau_cam=0.20 False-Safe vs Calibrated tau_cam=0.40 Safety

permissive_threshold_tau_cam_0_20.outcome: FALSE_SAFE (Corridor admitted because rho_fov 0.28 >= 0.20, but entity actually exits FOV at 1.13s).

calibrated_threshold_tau_cam_0_40.outcome: SAFE_REJECTION (Corridor rejected because rho_fov 0.28 < 0.40; system selects safe corridor or stops).

cases.scientific_significance: Validates why tau_cam=0.40 (1/e threshold) is optimal and prevents 5.0% false-safe hazard rate observed at 0.20.

cases.title: Borderline Uncertainty: Continuous Probability in the Transition Zone
cases.analysis: In this transition regime (0.40 <= rho_fov <= 0.60), stochastic variations in walker angular drift produce partial sample survival. The continuous soft weighting w_i = prod I(|phi|) * q_BR(phi_dot) smoothly reflects this epistemic uncertainty rather than snapping to an abrupt binary cliff.
cases.scientific_significance: Demonstrates smooth, well-calibrated probabilistic output (Brier score 0.152) near physical decision thresholds.
